formulas.ascii: p_i = min(m (M_i + 1), P + 1) / (P + 1); g_i = #{p : s_ip >= s_i}, l_i = #{p : s_ip <= s_i}; the default two-sided tail has m = 2 and M_i = min(g_i, l_i), so a row whose simulations all tie the observed value has p = 1. greater: m = 1, M = g; lesser: m = 1, M = l; folded: m = 1, M = #{|s_ip - mean| >= |s_i - mean|}; directed: m = 1, M = min(g, l). Each simulation s_ip assigns k_i distinct other rows (Philox draw, partial Fisher-Yates) to the focus row neighbor slots; the observed and simulated terms use the same f32 expression. The p-values lie on the grid k/(P+1).
